limitations: No actual encoded payload history is available in the compact summaries.
Predictive incremental cap information is not a causal action-value or QoE effect.
All panels are previously read development evidence on four authored schedules and twelve sources.
Source/regime CV partitions do not create an untouched validation panel.
No calibrated safety probability, closed-loop learned policy, or revised simulator is evaluated.

partitions.regime_cv: train on range, leave each complete authored network regime out; no hyperparameter selection
partitions.source_cv: train on range, leave each complete source out; no hyperparameter selection
partitions.transfer: fit once on all range sessions, freeze, describe ladder and margin; both already read, same sources; not blind validation
